patch.motion_tax.title: MOTION TAX
patch.motion_tax.sideEffect: Moving builds Heat. At maximum Heat, lose 1 Integrity.
patch.motion_tax.tactic: Stop briefly to vent Heat quickly.
patch.retaliation_echo.title: RETALIATION ECHO
patch.retaliation_echo.sideEffect: Every fourth Pulse creates a delayed blast at its origin.
patch.retaliation_echo.tactic: The blast can also damage enemies.
patch.hostile_turbo.title: HOSTILE TURBO
patch.hostile_turbo.tactic: Telegraphs stay readable, so position before each shot.
patch.frame_burst.title: FRAME BURST
patch.frame_burst.sideEffect: Every 5 seconds enemies surge for 0.6 seconds.
patch.frame_burst.tactic: Move to safety during the frame warning.
patch.phase_leak.title: PHASE LEAK
patch.phase_leak.fix: Enemies no longer merge on collision.
patch.phase_leak.sideEffect: Marked walls vanish for 1.5 seconds every 6 seconds.
patch.phase_leak.tactic: Use the opening as a shortcut or emergency escape.
patch.duplicate_fault.title: DUPLICATE FAULT
patch.duplicate_fault.fix: Enemies no longer merge on collision.
patch.duplicate_fault.sideEffect: Each enemy creates one 1-HP echo on its first hit.

patch.motion_tax.survivalBenefit: Pulse deals +1 damage and gains 14% radius per tier.
patch.motion_tax.survivalRisk: Moving builds Heat. Overheating costs 1 Integrity.
patch.retaliation_echo.survivalBenefit: Every fourth Pulse leaves a delayed blast that damages enemies.
patch.retaliation_echo.survivalRisk: The delayed blast can also damage you.
patch.hostile_turbo.survivalBenefit: Defeated enemies grant +100% XP per tier.
patch.frame_burst.survivalBenefit: Pulse cooldown is 18% shorter per tier.
patch.frame_burst.survivalRisk: Enemies enter a violent burst every 5 seconds.
patch.phase_leak.survivalBenefit: Magenta barriers periodically open into escape routes.
patch.phase_leak.survivalRisk: Enemies ignore those barriers and can cut through first.
patch.duplicate_fault.survivalBenefit: Defeating a duplicate grants double XP and score.
patch.duplicate_fault.survivalRisk: The first hit on each enemy creates a fast 1-HP duplicate.
patch.motion_tax.survivalBenefit.tier2: Stand still for 0.75s to charge Vent: next Pulse +2 damage and Heat -25.
patch.motion_tax.survivalRisk.tier2: Moving still builds Heat and overheating still causes damage.
patch.motion_tax.survivalBenefit.tier3: Overheating releases a Heat Burst that deals 2 damage to nearby enemies.
patch.motion_tax.survivalRisk.tier3: Heat Burst does not prevent the 1 Integrity overheat cost.
patch.retaliation_echo.survivalBenefit.t: Echo pulls nearby enemies toward its center during the warning.
patch.retaliation_echo.survivalRisk.tier: You must evade both the gathered enemies and the self-damaging blast.
patch.retaliation_echo.survivalBenefit.t: Echo deals 2 damage and no longer damages the player.
patch.retaliation_echo.survivalRisk.tier: Enemies become more densely packed before detonation.
patch.hostile_turbo.survivalBenefit.tier: Every third kill creates one bonus Data Shard.
Kills grant 1.5s of 35% additional Pulse cooldown reduction.
patch.hostile_turbo.survivalRisk.tier3: You must keep defeating accelerated enemies to sustain Overclock.
patch.frame_burst.survivalBenefit.tier2: Gain 1.5s of Player Overclock after each enemy Burst ends.
patch.frame_burst.survivalRisk.tier2: You must survive the original enemy surge before Overclock begins.
patch.frame_burst.survivalBenefit.tier3: Pulse deals +1 damage during Frame Overclock.
patch.frame_burst.survivalRisk.tier3: The 1.5s power window demands precise attack timing.
patch.phase_leak.survivalBenefit.tier2: Move 20% faster while phase barriers are open.
patch.phase_leak.survivalRisk.tier2: Enemies continue to ignore phase barriers at all times.
patch.phase_leak.survivalBenefit.tier3: Ignore all incoming damage while phase barriers are open.
patch.phase_leak.survivalRisk.tier3: The guard window is brief and tied to the barrier cycle.
patch.duplicate_fault.survivalBenefit.ti: Defeated duplicates burst for 1 damage in a 70 radius.
patch.duplicate_fault.survivalRisk.tier2: The first hit on every enemy still creates a fast duplicate.
patch.duplicate_fault.survivalBenefit.ti: Duplicate bursts deal 2 in a 90 radius and duplicate rewards become 3x.
patch.duplicate_fault.survivalRisk.tier3: Larger chain reactions require accepting denser duplicate packs.
